entry.title: Telekom Tower
entry.note: Mapped anchor and signed roof frame retain real236m helipad at its mapped center. The engineer plan is rigidly registered to the mapped core/roof projection; antenna is NNW of helipad, corroborated by architect tm-img1 with KL Tower backdrop. Exact lower-wing outer feet are reconstructed because the OSM envelope follows roof boundaries. SourceY0 is the tower entrance apron. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
